title: 第109章 唐逸小儿，别太狂妄了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 整个鹿鸣湖沉寂了一瞬，瞬间就像是巨石砸进湖中，掀起惊涛骇浪。“唐逸小儿，你别太狂妄了！”“无知小儿，当着我们的面，你竟敢还如此无法无天，猖狂！”“唐画，别给我留面子，狠狠收拾他，让他知道大哥永远是大哥。”“……”很多大臣气得暴跳如雷，太猖狂了，简直半点不将他们放在眼里。他们可都是大炎位高权重的豪族权贵，现在在一个小小的锦衣卫百户眼中，竟然连垃圾都不如。是可忍孰不可忍！有皇帝庇护，你真以为可以为所欲为？！不，有唐画在，皇帝保不住你。很多人当场就找了唐画，要唐画收拾唐逸。小诗仙又怎么样？三元及第的唐画，难道还比你差？“娘的，太狂了，好想灭了他，看他求饶的样子！”看着台上的唐逸，站在龙斩身侧的孙霸咬牙低声说道。“是有点该死……”龙斩这时用手帕轻轻擦拭着唇角，眼中也冒着冷光。他是谁？暗京楼京都分舵的舵主，死在他手中的人没有一千也有八百了。但就是他这样一个人人畏惧的魔头，现在在唐逸眼中竟然是垃圾？简直不能忍啊！“有意思，这些年见到的大炎人都是软骨头，现在总算有个硬气点的了。”宇文封盯着台上的唐逸，抬起的手缓缓捏成拳，笑容充满狠戾：“我就喜欢这种有骨气的男人，打断他们骨头的时候，那种惨嚎声简直让人陶醉。”“述里虎，你说，唐逸能在本王手中坚持多久？”述里虎想到曾经被宇文封削成人棍的大炎人，心头都有些发毛，嘴角却冷笑道：“就这种人也配入三王子的眼？落在三皇子手中，恐怕三皇子还没动手，他先吓得屁滚尿流了。”宇文封指尖轻轻敲着椅背，看向唐逸的目光就像是在看一件绝世珍宝一般，道：“不不不，他今日狂妄得成功吸引了我的注意，而且还是本王苦苦找寻的小诗仙。”“告诉暗京楼的人，等下动手的时候务必留下唐逸，我要好好的和他玩玩。”“砍他，肯定比砍那些小屁孩有意思多了。”述里虎闻言脸色微僵，暗京楼那群人只认钱，要想留唐逸性命估计得加钱。别说敌人，就是萧棣此时看着唐逸手也下意识落在刀柄上，靠，你要不要重新组织一下语言？知不知道什么叫友军？你这狠起来连友军都要干啊！唐逸看着气势汹涌的众人，嘴角也是猛地抽了抽。皇帝说的话，所有人将怒火集中在他身上，他说话……所有人还是将怒火集中在他身上，合着不敢对皇帝怎么样，火全部冲我来是吧？真当我没脾气？还想让唐画收拾我？知不知道你们寄予厚望的仔，其实是个假货啊！这么一想唐逸忽然就不生气了，你们不是喜欢捧唐画吗？那我就让你们知道什么叫捧得越高，摔得越狠。“唐画？你们也太高看他了。”唐逸睨了一眼唐画，丝毫不给面子：“别怪我没提醒你们，想要用他来压制我？你们也不问问，他有那个本事吗，他……配吗？！”唐画脸色瞬间难看至极，拳头更是死死捏紧，骨节发白。说到这里，唐逸目光环视全场，淡淡道：“为了给你们自己留点脸面，我给你们一个选择，自己认输吧！”“自己认输，总比等下脸被按在地上踩，要舒服得多。”听到这话，全场再度喧嚣起来，一众大臣气得七窍生烟，恨不得亲自下场将唐逸给生撕了。连同准备参与沈园诗会的一群士子才子，这时候脸色也是阴沉无比，他们大多数都是受到世家大族的驱使，只要确定小诗仙的身份，便一起联手将小诗仙给干了。但现在这种情况和他们想的不一样啊！现在不是他们联手先将小诗仙干了，而是小诗仙一个人要干他们全部。没错，就是全部，满朝文臣和勋贵豪族以及他们这些才子学子。简直不要太疯狂！然而，很快他们便错愕地发现，唐逸并不只是针对他们，此时他已经看向东虞和北狄使团的方向，笑着开了口。“至于外邦的朋友，今日就先别凑热闹了吧！”“毕竟今日沈园诗会，是我大炎自己的事，诸位参与进来性质就不一样了。”“诸位还是站在边上看戏就行，要是也入戏了，等下和这些家伙一起丢人，那就不好看了。”唐逸虽然嘴角带笑，但声音却带着冷意。今日沈园诗会，他已经知道东虞和北狄有人会参加，而东虞和北狄正勾结要分割大炎北境，现在他们参与进来能安好心？炎文帝是皇帝，人家使团提出来他不好拒绝，但那些文臣竟然不帮着皇帝就算了，反而还答应了下来。对他们来说要弄死他这个小诗仙，自然是多个人多份力，先弄死他这个小诗仙再说。至于北境……北境关他们屁事！闻言，秦钰眼睛眯了起来，宇文封顿时满脸杀意。好嘛，我们还没出手，你倒先忍不住了。“唐兄说笑了，既然已经说好要参加，今日在下若不出席，岂不是背信弃义？”秦钰站了起来，冲着唐逸拱了拱手：“在下秦钰，今日愿领教领教唐兄的才学，以正自身不足，还望唐兄成全。”话落，也不等唐逸说话，秦钰便已经离席，向舞台走去。“呵，那些酸溜溜的东西，本王子不会，本王子……只会杀人。”宇文封也站了起来，向着舞台走去：“小子，你最好祈祷自己有点本事，否则等下我会将你给生生撕成碎片。”比诗词是不可能的，他要强迫唐逸比武。摔跤，箭法，力量……随便一样，他都能将唐逸这瘦骨嶙峋的大炎人踩在脚下！只是唐逸看着他们两人，却只是笑着摇了摇头。没看出来吗？我是故意的激怒你们的，你们不下场，怎么收拾你们？收拾了你们，也算是鼓舞一下大炎的士气吧！“唐逸，你别太过分了，也别怪为兄心狠了。”唐画咬着牙，心里在持续破防。见到秦钰和宇文封已经登台，他当即来了底气，直接上前两步，冲着炎文帝拱手道：“陛下，唐逸太过无法无天了，视满朝文武于无物，臣请陛下立即开始沈园诗会。”“臣，愿为满朝大臣，为大炎文坛，扫除这无君无父的狂妄之徒！”唐画声音嘹亮，传遍全场，所有人的目光都落在他身上，露出嘉许之色。说得好，不愧是我们看中的人，一定要将唐逸踩在脚下，让他知道天高地厚。
content_en: The entire Luming Lake was silent for a moment, and it was like a huge boulder smashing into the lake, causing a stormy sea."Tang Yi, don't be too arrogant!" "Ignorant boy, how dare you be so lawless and arrogant in front of us!" "Tang Hua, don't save face for me, deal with him severely and let him know that the eldest brother will always be the eldest brother." "..." Many ministers were furious with anger. They were so arrogant that they didn't take them seriously at all.They are all wealthy and powerful people with high positions in Great Yan, but now in the eyes of a small Jinyiwei Baihu, they are even worse than trash.It is unbearable!With the emperor's protection, do you really think you can do whatever you want?!No, the emperor cannot protect you as long as Tang Hua is here.Many people approached Tang Hua on the spot and asked Tang Hua to deal with Tang Yi.What about the little Shixian?Is Sanyuan Jidi's Tang painting worse than you?"Damn, you're so crazy. I really want to kill him and watch him beg for mercy!" Sun Ba, standing next to Long Zhan, gritted his teeth and whispered as he looked at Tang Yi on the stage."It's a bit damn..." Long Zhan gently wiped the corners of his lips with a handkerchief at this time, and there was a cold light in his eyes.who is he?The helmsman of the Kyoto branch of Anjing Tower, not only a thousand but also eight hundred people died in his hands.But he, a demon that everyone fears, is now trash in Tang Yi's eyes?It’s simply unbearable!"It's interesting. All the Dayan people I've seen over the years have been weak, but now I finally have someone with a bit more toughness." Yu Wenfeng stared at Tang Yi on the stage, raised his hand and slowly clenched it into a fist, his smile full of cruelty: "I just like this kind of man with backbone, the kind of miserable howl he makes when he breaks their bones.The sound is simply intoxicating."Shu Lihu, how long can Tang Yi last in the hands of this king?"Shu Lihu felt a little scared when he thought about the great Yanren who was once beaten into a stick by Yu Wenfeng, but he sneered: "Is this kind of person worthy of falling into the hands of the third prince?"I'm afraid that before the third prince takes action, he will be scared to death." Yu Wenfeng tapped his fingertips on the back of the chair, looking at Tang Yi as if he were looking at a unique treasure, and said: "No, no, no, he was so arrogant today that he successfully attracted my attention, and it was also the little poem that I was looking for so hard.Immortal." "Tell the people in Anjing Tower to keep Tang Yi when we do it.I want to have a good time with him." "It will definitely be more interesting to kill him than to kill those little brats." Shulihu's face stiffened when he heard this. The people in Anjing Tower only care about money. If they want to save Tang Yi's life, they will probably have to pay more.Not to mention the enemy, even Xiao Di subconsciously dropped his hand on the handle of the knife when he saw Tang Yi at this moment. Damn, do you want to reorganize your language?Do you know what friendly forces are?If you are so ruthless, you will even do it to friendly troops!Tang Yi looked at the angry crowd and twitched the corners of his mouth.When the emperor said something, everyone focused their anger on him. When he spoke... everyone still focused their anger on him. They didn't dare to do anything to the emperor. All the fire was directed at me, right?Do you really think I have no temper?Still want Tang Hua to deal with me?Do you know that the guy you have high hopes for is actually a fake?Thinking of this, Tang Yi suddenly stopped being angry. Don't you like to admire Tang paintings?Then I will let you know what it means that the higher you praise, the harder you fall."Tang Hua? You think too highly of him." Tang Yi glanced at Tang Hua without giving any face: "Don't blame me for not reminding you, and want to use him to suppress me? You don't even ask, does he have what it takes? Is he... worthy?!" Tang Hua's face instantly became extremely ugly, and his fists were clenched tightly, and his joints turned white.At this point, Tang Yi looked around the audience and said calmly: "In order to save some face for yourselves, I will give you a choice, admit defeat!" "It is much more comfortable to admit defeat than wait for your face to be pressed to the ground and stepped on." Hearing this, the entire audience became noisy again. All the ministers were so angry that they wanted to go out and tear Tang Yi alive.Together with a group of scholars and talents who were preparing to participate in the Shen Yuan Poetry Club, their faces were extremely gloomy at this time. Most of them were driven by the aristocratic families. As long as the identity of the little Shixian was confirmed, they joined forces to kill the little Shixian.But now the situation is different from what they thought!Now it's not that they join forces to kill Xiao Shixian first, but Xiao Shixian wants to kill them all alone.That's right, all of them, the civil servants and noble families of the Manchu Dynasty, as well as their talented students.Just don't go too crazy!However, they soon discovered to their surprise that Tang Yi was not just targeting them. At this time, he had already looked in the direction of the Dongyu and Beidi missions, smiled and spoke."As for foreign friends, please don't join in the fun today!" "After all, today's Shenyuan Poetry Recital is my own business, and the nature of your participation will be different." "You can just stand on the sidelines and watch the show. If you get involved, it will be embarrassing with these guys later. It will not look good." Although Tang Yi was smiling, his voice was cold.Today at the Shenyuan Poetry Recital, he already knew that someone from Dongyu and Beidi would attend, and Dongyu and Beidi were colluding to divide the Northern Territory of Great Yan. Can they feel at ease now that they are participating?Emperor Yanwen was the emperor, and it was difficult for him to refuse the envoy's proposal, but those civil servants did not bother to help the emperor, but agreed.For them, if they wanted to kill this little poetry fairy, they would naturally need multiple people and multiple efforts. They should kill him, this little poetry fairy, first.As for the North...the North is none of their business!Hearing this, Qin Yu's eyes narrowed, and Yu Wenfeng's face suddenly filled with murderous intent.Well, we haven't taken action yet, but you can't help it anymore."Brother Tang is joking. Since I have agreed to participate, wouldn't it be a breach of trust if I don't show up today?" Qin Yu stood up and raised his hands to Tang Yi: "My Qin Yu, today I would like to learn from Brother Tang's talent and learning to correct my shortcomings and hope that Brother Tang will succeed." After saying this, before Tang Yi could say anything, Qin Yu had already left the table and walked to the stage."Oh, I don't know those sour things. I can only kill people." Yu Wenfeng also stood up and walked towards the stage: "Boy, you'd better pray that you have some skills, otherwise I will tear you into pieces later." Poetry competition is impossible, he will force Tang Yi to compete in martial arts.Wrestling, archery, strength...anything, he can trample Tang Yi, a skinny man like Yan, under his feet!Tang Yi looked at the two of them and just smiled and shook his head.Don't you see it?I provoked you on purpose. If you don't come to an end, how can I deal with you?receive
title_en: Chapter 109: Tang Yi, don’t be too arrogant!
